requirements.quote: /home/user/backup_2023 exists and contains only the two files specified above, no extras.
Copy **only** the lines that contain the literal substring “ERROR”.

check.cmd: cd /home/user/source_logs && for f in $(LC_ALL=C ls app*.log | LC_ALL=C sort); do grep -F ERROR "$f"; done | cmp -s - /home/user/backup_2023/filtered_errors.txt

requirements.quote: Process the matching files in alphabetical order and **append** error lines in the exact order they already appear in each file.

check.cmd: cd /home/user/source_logs && for f in $(LC_ALL=C ls app*.log | LC_ALL=C sort); do grep -F ERROR "$f"; done | cmp -s - /home/user/backup_2023/filtered_errors.txt

requirements.quote: Lines that originated from non-matching files (e.g. “system.log”) must never appear in this extract.

check.cmd: [ "$(cd /home/user/source_logs && for f in $(LC_ALL=C ls *.log | LC_ALL=C sort); do n=$(awk 'END{print NR}' "$f"); e=$(grep -c ERROR "$f"); case "$f" in app*.log) s=included;; *) s=skipped;; esac; printf '%s|%s|%s|%s\n' "$f" "$n" "$e" "$s"; done)" = "$(sed '$d' /home/user/backup_2023/backup_report.log)" ]

requirements.quote: One such line is required for **every** “*.log” file present in /home/user/source_logs/, listed in alphabetical order.
`<total_error_lines>`= cumulative ERROR lines copied into filtered_errors.txt

check.cmd: [ "$(tail -n 1 /home/user/backup_2023/backup_report.log | cut -d'|' -f2-4)" = "$(cd /home/user/source_logs && ls *.log | wc -l | tr -d ' ')|$(cd /home/user/source_logs && ls app*.log | wc -l | tr -d ' ')|$(awk 'END{print NR}' /home/user/backup_2023/filtered_errors.txt)" ]

requirements.quote: Ensure there is **no trailing whitespace** on any line.
Must contain, at its top level, the following two members:

check.cmd: [ "$(tar -tzf /home/user/backup_2023.tar.gz | sed 's#^\./##' | cut -d/ -f1 | grep -v '^$' | LC_ALL=C sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')" = "backup_2023 source_logs " ]

requirements.quote: complete directory “source_logs” with every file exactly as it existed under /home/user/source_logs

check.cmd: cd /home/user/source_logs && for f in *; do (tar -xzOf /home/user/backup_2023.tar.gz "source_logs/$f" 2>/dev/null || tar -xzOf /home/user/backup_2023.tar.gz "./source_logs/$f" 2>/dev/null) | cmp -s - "$f" || echo "MISMATCH $f"; done

requirements.quote: the directory “backup_2023” with both newly-created files “filtered_errors.txt” and “backup_report.log”

check.cmd: cd /home/user/backup_2023 && for f in filtered_errors.txt backup_report.log; do (tar -xzOf /home/user/backup_2023.tar.gz "backup_2023/$f" 2>/dev/null || tar -xzOf /home/user/backup_2023.tar.gz "./backup_2023/$f" 2>/dev/null) | cmp -s - "$f" || echo "MISMATCH $f"; done
